The 2026-10-09 check passed interactively but failed from the runner, so the grant probably sits on a different process. Record that path on T-351 so the ask names the right app. (2) Have the runner re-run the preflight on each sweep and, the moment it prints READY, close T-351 and start T-132's five captures automatically. Do not mark T-351 done from an interactive shell again; only a READY printed from the runner counts.
